https://cursor.com/changelog/agent-sdk.title: Agent SDK
https://cursor.com/changelog/agent-sdk.summary: The Agent SDK is available today. It allows you to define an agent as a folder of code, test it with evals, and deploy it to Cursor or your own infrastructure.

https://cursor.com/changelog/cloud-agent.title: Cloud Agent Canvases and Environment Improvements
https://cursor.com/changelog/cloud-agent.summary: Cloud agents can now build interactive canvases as part of their work. Share a finished canvas with your team by sending its link.

https://cursor.com/changelog/origin-app-.title: Origin App Marketplace
https://cursor.com/changelog/origin-app-.summary: Origin now integrates with over 20 apps for deployments, CI, code review, security, monitoring, and project management, from partners including Cloudflare, Linear, Sentry, and Socket Security.

https://cursor.com/changelog/remote-cont.title: Remote control for local agents
https://cursor.com/changelog/remote-cont.summary: You can now see and reply to the local agents running on your computer from the Cursor iOS app.

https://cursor.com/changelog/rollouts-an.title: Rollouts and Security Review
https://cursor.com/changelog/rollouts-an.summary: Today we're launching two Cursor bots for the last mile of shipping code. Rollouts watches every change as it deploys and reports its health per environment. Security Review reports exploitable bugs on every pull request.
